captureForm: One canonical .gltf source per distinct manifest asset; GLB equivalence remains byte-locked at L0-L5.

goldenComparison.justification: The initial DirectX11/DXVK campaign requires two independent production-viewer processes to produce byte-identical PNG files before any renderer-owned golden is accepted. The renderer has its own golden set; no EasyGL, Vulkan or SOFTWARE image or tolerance is reused.

resolvedDivergences.symptom: An absent optional baseColorTexture sampled an unbound D3D11 SRV as transparent black, making factor-only PBR geometry invisible in transparent reference captures.
resolvedDivergences.resolution: The DirectX11 PBR binding now supplies the semantic opaque-white fallback for an absent base-colour map, guarded by both the cross-renderer source policy and a real DXVK pixel test.

resolvedDivergences.symptom: SkinnedEffect intentionally samples its texture even when none is assigned, and an unbound D3D11 SRV returned transparent black, erasing an otherwise valid untextured KHR_materials_unlit skin.
resolvedDivergences.resolution: The DirectX11 plain-skinned binding now substitutes the semantic opaque-white texture used by Vulkan, EasyGL and OpenGL, guarded by a source-policy regression and a real DXVK production-viewer capture that matches EasyGL byte-for-byte.

gltf-required-extension-unsupported.reason: The asset explicitly requires an unsupported extension and must not be approximated.

mode-triangle-strip-morph.reason: The generic positive-octant camera sees the back of this deliberately non-planar morphed strip. Disabling culling makes its pixel path observable; dedicated culling fixtures retain culling coverage.

xf-rot-x90.reason: The generic positive-octant camera sees the back of the +X-rotated one-sided triangle. Disabling culling makes the transformed geometry observable without changing the fixture.

skin-73-joints.errorContains: has 73 joints, but the GPU bone palette holds 72
skin-73-joints.reason: CNA refuses a well-formed skin that exceeds its documented GPU palette instead of truncating it.

skin-unnormalized.reason: The fixture deliberately leaves one zero-weight vertex unweighted. Its zero skin matrix collapses that corner onto another corner, so the single triangle is degenerate and the clear framebuffer is the expected pixel result.

bad-accessor-out-of-bounds.errorContains: reads 36 bytes from a bufferView of 24 bytes
bad-accessor-out-of-bounds.reason: The loader's pre-validation checked arithmetic refuses an out-of-bounds accessor.

bad-accessor-count-overflow.errorContains: declares a byte span that overflows
bad-accessor-count-overflow.reason: The loader refuses overflowing accessor span arithmetic before reading data.

bad-index-out-of-range.reason: The full production load rejects this malformed index document during structural validation; the lower-layer extractor diagnostic is tested separately.

accessor-count-mismatch.reason: The full production load rejects mismatched attribute counts during structural validation; the extractor's defence-in-depth is tested separately.

skin-joint-index-out-of-range.reason: A weighted joint index outside the skin is refused instead of silently rebound.

bad-animation-input-order.reason: A decreasing animation time domain has no defensible playback interpretation.
